name: WD14 Tagger
description: Local WD14 image tagging with ONNX models. Fully offline; runs EVA02, ViT, ConvNext, SwinV2 and MOAT tagger models, writes tags back to the library.

zh-CN.name: WD14 本地打标
zh-CN.description: 使用本地 ONNX WD14 模型离线打标。支持 EVA02、ViT、ConvNext、SwinV2、MOAT 系列，标签写回资源库。

author: menghuan

settings.title: Model directory
settings.description: Directory containing WD14 .onnx + .csv files (e.g. ComfyUI wd14 tagger models folder).

settings.title: Model
settings.description: Choose a WD14 model. Labels include the source repository, tag count and the model-directory status found during this update: 本地有 means both matching .onnx and .csv files exist; 本地不完整 means one file is missing.
